prompts.prompt:
Create a meticulous automotive exterior flush door-handle construction reference sheet, GT01 D11, white technical studio background, landscape 3:2, exceptionally clear close-up engineering product illustration. This is an AUTHOR DESIGN SHAPE REFERENCE, not certified manufacturing data. Make a SINGLE consistent manually operated push-one-end / pull-other-end flush handle, NEVER a pop-out parallel four-bar handle. Local axes X along its length, Y outward from door, Z vertical. No car beauty shot.
Keep the identity a slim British-racing-green capsule face, 138 mm length, 22 mm high, subtly crowned face, rounded ends radius 11. Black perimeter housing flange 154 x 38 mm with a capsule opening 145 x 29 mm. Behind the face a black open carrier pocket 34 mm deep, TWO real mounting ears at X +/-85 with real screw through-holes, front and rear wall thickness readable, no solid fake cavity.
Top half: large assembled outside view, assembled backside view and an accurate horizontal section through the Z-axis pivot showing green lever as a single hinged member pivoting at X -46 mm, Y -10 mm. Face is Y=0, case extends toward negative Y. Handle must turn about the VERTICAL Z axis; pivot is near the left end. A pressed LEFT short end tips inward, RIGHT long end swings out. Include a ghosted 30 degree open position with a curved arrow, and an unmistakable section showing true pivot bore, pin and inner cavity.
Bottom half: one spacious exploded axonometric in assembly order with numbered individual parts and no overlap: 01 green face with continuous integral rear rib and drilled pivot boss; 02 black open carrier with fixed top and bottom hinge ears; 03 shouldered stainless vertical pivot pin with true retaining groove; 04 five-turn torsion spring with TWO distinct tangent legs; 05 separate Bowden cable lever with real pivot hole and barrel-nipple seat; 06 separate flat black perimeter EPDM gasket with true central opening; 07 two Torx mounting screws; 08 small elastomer travel stop; 09 separate E retaining clip. Make components real 3D forms, not icon symbols. Add small enlarged details of the spring legs seated against case and handle, of the pin groove and E clip, and of cable barrel seated in lever. Connector/mating relationships must be visible. Fine neutral linework with subtle material shading, green only on face, satin steel pin and screws, black polymer case and elastomer. Readable sparse English labels, numbers and dimension arrows only where actually supportable. Title GT01 / D11 FLUSH HANDLE. Footer AUTHOR DESIGN / SHAPE AND ASSEMBLY STUDY. No logo, no invented certification, no fake tiny text.
prompts.review: Parts and general arrangement study. Rejected complete-sheet authority: inconsistent pivot axis among panels; no source measurement.

prompts.prompt:
Using the green flush handle in the provided assembly sheet as design identity only, produce ONE exceptionally clear technical reference for the SINGLE GREEN HANDLE LEVER, D11-P01. Six large panels on pure white, sparse fine gray alignment lines, subtle green metallic finish, easily understood 3D back surface. Correct the previous sheet's inconsistent pivot orientation: hinge axis is VERTICAL Z in installed orientation. Front face is a horizontal capsule, overall LENGTH 138, HEIGHT 22, end radius11, face thickness3. Local X along length, Y outward, Z up. Outer face at Y=0, back face atY=-3. Rear integral mounting web leads to ONE vertical bored pivot boss at X=-46,Y=-10. Boss outside diameter10, true bore4.10, boss spans Z=-3..+7. The WEB MUST CONTINUOUSLY JOIN THE FACE AND BOSS, no separate floating cylinder. Boss hole opens on upward and downward surfaces only, not toward the viewer of the green front face. Web is behind face with thickness Z=4, from Y=-3 toY=-10 at pivot; keeps bore unobstructed.
Panel 1 large exact face elevation preserving138:22 ratio. Panel2 top view X/Y showing3mm front face and rearweb/boss, true borevisible. Panel3 rear view showing webandboss with verticalaxis dashed. Panel4 enlarged isometric from behind and above showing actualverticalhole. Panel5 sectional vertical cut through pivotboss reveals4.10throughbore and10outside. Panel6 assembled orientation inset: onlyghosted carrier, this SAME greenlever on one verticalpin, short leftend pressed inward and longrightend rotated outward30deg about Z, curvedarrow. Do not confuse this with upward/downward flap motion. No other components, no horizontalpivot holes, no extra ears or screw holes, no artwork crowding. English labels with exact numbers listed only. Title GT01 / D11-P01 HANDLE LEVER; footer AUTHOR DESIGN SHAPE REFERENCE.
prompts.review: Adopt slender capsule and one continuous back rib/boss. Reject rear-view Y hole and cross-view scaling. Physical hole is Z only.

prompts.prompt:
Generate a high-resolution white technical product reference sheet for ONE automotive flush door-handle carrier, GT01 D11-P02. Single black polymer open capsule pocket, long X direction, shallow Z height, depth into negative Y. AUTHOR DESIGN. Six readable large views: front, rear, top, isometric looking into open pocket, horizontal section through cavity, enlarged vertical pivot-hole detail. The black front FLANGE is 154 wide x38 high excluding its TWO lateral ears. Front opening 145 wide x29 high. Each end has one integral rounded mounting ear with5.2throughhole alongY, ear centresX=-85/+85. Overallwidthincludingears186. The carrier cavity is NOT a solid slab. Bodyoutercapsule152x36, bodyextendsY=-5 to-34. FrontflangeY=-5..-1. The true empty capsule cavity startsY=-1 and endsY=-31.5: 2.5mm rearfloor. Sidewalls3.5thick. Capsuleendssemicircles, NOT rectangularcuboidwithbeveledcorners. Clear uniform black satinmaterial with visibleedges and lightinside.
There are TWO aligned true verticalZ pivot holes diameter4.2 through upperandlowerwalls, BOTH centeredX=-46,Y=-10. These are actual holes in the long upper/lower walls, not extra floatingbearingears. Show how a verticalghosted pin passestopwall, emptycavity, bottomwall in one enlarged cutsection. There is NO cablelever, no spring, no grip, no screws fitted, no fake cylindricalpostsblockingcavity, no unrequestedholes. Outerendearholes must persist identically infront,rearandisometric. prompts.review: Rejected: dark paper, rear view is another cavity, duplicate top holes and contradictory axes.

prompts.prompt: Correct this technical sheet. WHITE PAPER BACKGROUND RGB255255255, black fully legible text, LIGHT GRAY polymer body so internal cavity is visible. No dark vignette or dark background at all. Keep six panels and all dimensions but fix geometry contradictions: the REAR VIEW must show a CLOSED back wall, no open cavity, no internal crossbars. TOP VIEW must show ONE vertical pivot hole, at X=-46,Y=-10: the opposite bottom-wall hole is coaxial beneath it, not a second hole next to it. No false tubes or rods inside case. Front and isometric show an OPEN capsule pocket with rounded semicircular end walls and smooth continuous rear wall, not boxy rectangular socket. Last detail is VERTICAL Z pin through two3.5mm thick upper/lower walls separatedby29mm emptycavity; label3.5 thickness,29 gap,4.2 bore, axisZ. Delete Y depth values fromthislastdetail because those belongtohorizontal cavitydepth view. The bottomleftsectionalone shows bodydepth33, internaldepth30.5,rearfloor2.5, flange4. These are AUTHOR DESIGN drawings not certifiedmeasures. ALL LETTERING HIGH CONTRAST BLACK ON WHITE. Make physicallysamepartinallviews.
prompts.review: Readability and closed rear corrected; top dimensions and roundness remain illustrative. Native geometry is independently inspected but not measured source.
